query: SELECT cl.id, cl.title, cm.title as module_title, LENGTH(cl.content) as content_length FROM course_lessons cl JOIN course_modules cm ON cl.moduleId = cm.id WHERE cm.title LIKE '%semiconductor%' OR cm.title LIKE '%electric%' OR cm.title LIKE '%motor%' OR cm.title LIKE '%VFD%' OR cm.title LIKE '%PLC%' OR cm.title LIKE '%power%' OR cl.title LIKE '%circuit%' OR cl.title LIKE '%diode%' OR cl.title LIKE '%transistor%' OR cl.title LIKE '%capacitor%' OR cl.title LIKE '%resistor%' OR cl.title LIKE '%inductor%' OR cl.title LIKE '%relay%' OR cl.title LIKE '%contactor%' OR cl.title LIKE '%transformer%' ORDER BY cm.title, cl.orderIndex;
